title: PuniRunes Puni 4 Anime Season to Premiere on October 4
content: The official website for the anime of Takara Tomy 's PuniRunes toyline announced on Saturday that the fourth anime season , PuniRunes Puni 4 , will premiere on October 4 at 9:15 a.m. (October 3 at 8:15 p.m. EDT).
author: ANN

title: Crunchyroll’s Solo Leveling Replacement Commences New Arc With Gorgeous First Look
content: Crunchyroll is currently streaming the perfect Solo Leveling replacement for fans awaiting the anime’s return. Solo Leveling has been one of the most successful manhwa and light novel series across the globe, long before the anime was ever confirmed.

title: Muichiro Tokito From Demon Slayer Gets 2026 Birthday Illustration by Ufotable
content: Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba revealed a new 2026 birthday illustration by ufotable to commemorate the birthday of Muichiro Tokito. The Mist Hashira celebrates his birthday on August 8.

title: Haikyu Confirms Exciting New Update For Fans Awaiting The Upcoming Film
content: When it comes to sports anime, no modern series can come close to the legacy and influence of Haikyu!! Written and illustrated by Haruichi Furudate, the manga began serialization in the Weekly Shonen Jump magazine in 2012 and reached its conclusion in 2020.

title: His Majesty the Demon King's Housekeeper Manga Ends in Next Chapter
content: The September issue of Akita Shoten 's Monthly Princess magazine announced on Thursday that writer Saiko Wadori and artist Mika Kajiyama 's His Majesty the Demon King's Housekeeper ( Maō Heika no Osōji-gakari ) manga will end in its next chapter in the magazine's November issue in October.

content: MAPPA is one of the most renowned animation studios in the industry, known for adapting some of the biggest anime series of all time, including Jujutsu Kaisen and Attack on Titan Final Season.

title: SAG-AFTRA Lists Voice Actor Michael Donovan's Death
content: Donovan had numerous roles in anime, including Ryoga Hibiki in the original Ranma ½ anime, Cye Mouri in Ronin Warriors , Zouken Matou in Fate/stay night: Heaven's Feel , Master Roshi in an older dub of Dragon Ball , and Primus in Transformers: Cybertron .
author: ANN

title: 3 Reasons Why Jujutsu Kaisen Season 2 Is the Anime’s Best Season
content: MAPPA’s Jujutsu Kaisen anime has been a sensation ever since it premiered in October 2020. The series introduced a darker edge that most shonen anime lack, proving that this element is what truly modernizes it.

title: Mechanical Designer Katsushi Murakami DIes at 83
content: Murakami was born on September 23, 1942 in Gifu, Japan. Murakami served as a mechanical designer for numerous anime including Shin Tetsujin 28 , Gold Lightan - The Golden Warrior , Machine Robo: Battle Hackers , Video Warrior Laserion , Reideen the Brave , Gekisō!
author: ANN
